repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.description_zh: 有效的 Agentic 技能框架和软件开发方法。

repos.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
repos.description_zh: 使用 Univer Office SDK 打造您自己的人工智能办公室。将编辑、计算、协作和文件处理引入您的产品中，供人员和 AI 代理使用。基于可扩展的开源内核构建。

repos.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
repos.description_zh: AG-UI：Agent 用户交互协议。将代理引入前端应用程序。

repos.description: Local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Cut, captions, reframe, loudness, platform exports. No cloud, no API keys.
repos.description_zh: 用于编码代理的本地视频编辑器：42 个 FFmpeg 工具，带有机器可读合同和 MCP 服务器，适用于 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex。剪切、字幕、重构、响度、平台导出。没有云，没有 API 密钥。

repos.description: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
repos.description_zh: PaperOrchestra 是一个用于自动化 AI 研究论文写作的多 Agent 框架。

repos.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
repos.description_zh: Orca 允许您通过自己的订阅运行一组编码代理（例如 Claude Code、Codex）。可在桌面、移动和远程运行时使用。

repos.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
repos.description_zh: 用于错误搜寻和外部红队工作的 Claude Code 技能包 - 82 项技能、15 个斜杠命令、涵盖 24 个核心漏洞类别的 681 个披露报告模式，以及企业身份 + 基础设施攻击矩阵。

repos.description: 江山时序 · 中国历史交互地图时间轴 (403 BCE – Present) | Interactive Historical Atlas of China across 18 dynasties, 198 territory snapshots, ancient-to-modern place genealogy & classical poetry routes

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.description_zh: Agent线束性能优化系统。 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等的技能、直觉、记忆、安全性和研究优先开发。

repos.description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills and plugins with quality gates, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior.
repos.description_zh: 用于评估 AI Agent 技能和插件的多层框架，具有质量门、语义重叠检测、综合评估数据集生成以及衡量技能如何影响 Agent 行为的实时 Agent 评估。

repos.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
repos.description_zh: 让您的 AI Agent 像房间里最懒的高级开发人员一样思考。最好的代码是你从未编写过的代码。

repos.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
repos.description_zh: 安全、快速、高效，经过阿里巴巴规模的实战考验。混合架构代码审查工具：确定性管道+LLM Agent，精确的行级注释，内置多语言规则集（NPE，线程安全，XSS，SQL注入），兼容OpenAI和Anthropic。

repos.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
repos.description_zh: 编码代理的设计词汇。更加优雅和大胆地驾驶，通过批评和审核进行审查，在 AI 味发货之前抓住它。

repos.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
repos.description_zh: Claude Code 面向股票投资者和交易者的技能——市场分析、技术图表、经济日历、筛选和交易策略开发。

repos.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

repos.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
repos.description_zh: 将任何代码库及其文档、SQL 架构、配置和 PDF 转换为可查询的知识图谱。 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的 /graphify 技能：局部确定性 AST 解析，每条边均已解释，无向量存储。
